headline: Last session: Sensex jumped 898 points and Nifty reclaimed 25,800 led by banking stocks.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 23 November.

why: Banking stocks rallied strongly with NIFTY Bank hitting a record high on the last trading day.
Foreign institutional inflows provided strong support to benchmark indices.
Markets recovered from early lower levels triggered by global AI selloff concerns.
Key sector gains in banking and IT helped Indian markets defy global market weakness.
whatHappening: On the last trading session, Sensex surged 898 points and Nifty 50 closed at 25,801.
Apollo Hospitals was among the top gainers leading the Nifty rally.
IndusInd Bank invoked clawback provisions against its former executive dating back to 2020.
Indian stock markets are closed today, Saturday, 21 November 2026, for the weekend.
summary:
On the last trading day, Indian benchmark indices staged a sharp rally with the Sensex jumping 898 points to reclaim 25,800.
The surge was primarily driven by record highs in banking stocks and strong foreign inflows that offset initial global weak cues.
The market is closed today due to the weekend and will resume trading on Monday, 23 November 2026.
